card.name: Final digit of a number in a range
card.fires_on: The last digit of a multi-digit number, mostly the 0 in values like 30 or 900, or a digit ending a range such as 2-4 in. It appears just before a unit such as mg, mL, mm or in.

modes.label: Trailing zero in doses
modes.description: The 0 that ends a round dose or measurement number before a unit.

modes.label: Digit ending a size range
modes.description: The last number of a metric or inch size range or dimension.

modes.label: Plus sign in an index
modes.description: A plus sign inside a subscript-style expression.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a number just before the unit, such as the 0 in 30 mg.
